title: Ends tonight
sub: Four sales that close Monday night: activewear, denim, pajamas and skincare.

brands.say: Vector faux leather jacket was $279, now $139.50, all eight sizes. Sable knit bomber $199 to $60. Surge quilted jacket $199 to $90.
brands.why_not: Homepage also advertises an extra 20% off sitewide, not reflected in these prices. Deepest markdowns are final sale.

items.name: Vector Jacket
items.note: Leather-look jacket, 50% off, 8/8 sizes, reads as fashion not gym

items.name: Sable Knit Bomber
items.note: 70% off fuzzy burgundy knit; 5/8 sizes, final sale

items.name: Surge Quilted Jacket
items.note: 55% off, all sizes, not tagged final sale

brands.say: Karlee denim chore jacket was $258, now $90, all sizes. Cassie high rise straight jean $188 to $94 in all 11 sizes. Ilona bubble hem dress $178 to $62.
brands.why_not: All three are final sale. Homepage headline is 30% off; these are the deeper sale-section prices.

items.name: Ilona Bubble Hem Dress
items.note: Navy bubble-hem mini, 65% off, all sizes

brands.say: Perfect Pima pajama shirt was $58, now $29, all seven sizes. Matching pajama pants $68 to $34. Cloud Cotton long sleeve tee and pant set $106 to $66.
brands.why_not: Low price points, so dollar savings are small. The pima pajama pieces are final sale and sold separately.

items.name: Pima Pajama Shirt
items.note: Navy piped PJ top, 50% off, 7/7 sizes

items.name: Cloud Cotton PJ Set
items.note: 38% off set, all sizes; img 1 is the on-model shot

brands.say: Radiant Cleansing Balm was $65, now $45.50. Extreme Recovery Cream $75 to $52.50. Face Oil No. 9 $85 to $59.50. No code needed.
brands.why_not: Flat 30% only, nothing deeper. Brand skews a little older than the audience. The balm's first photo has an award badge, so img 1 is used.
